run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend-proxy since 2026-11-17T05:28:51Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate alert on otel-demo/frontend-proxy is firing on a non-zero request error signal made of two distinct error sources, and the exact rule expression could not be recovered. (1) Recurring, low-rate 503s from the frontend-proxy Envoy pod: access logs show '503 UC upstream_reset_before_response_started{connection_termination}' for GET /api/recommendations, /api/products/* and /api/cart at 05:28:13, 05:30:42, 05:31:41, 05:33:31 and 05:35:56; the error signal was already non-zero from the first available metric sample (05:07) at ~1.1-6.7 error spans per 5 minutes, went to 0 at the 05:25 and 05:27 samples, and the first 503 after that quiet period is at 05:28:13 — 38s before the alert's 05:28:51 start. In the sampled traces the matching spans are frontend-proxy ingress with http.status_code 503 and a 'router frontend egress' span with http.status_code 0, i.e. the upstream (frontend) never returned a response; frontend's own error spans are 0 outside the burst below, so these look like connection-level resets rather than frontend application errors. The origin inside frontend is unverified because the frontend container produced no readable log lines in this window. (2) A discrete burst: 59 'POST /api/checkout HTTP/1.1' 500 - via_upstream lines from frontend-proxy between 05:29:14 and 05:30:54, matching checkout oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder and oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge ERROR span rates of 0.24-0.66/s at 05:30:30-05:32:30 and frontend POST /api/checkout error rates in the same interval; frontend-proxy error spans rose to 87.8 (sample 05:31), 133.3 (05:33) and 47.8 (05:35) per 5 minutes against a ~1-6/5m background. This burst is coincident with and mechanistically explained by a rollout restart of the single-replica Deployment payment at 05:29:08 (pod template annotation kubectl.kubernetes.io/restartedAt=2026-11-17T05:29:08Z): the old pod was killed at 05:29:11, the new container started at 05:29:11 and the pod reported Ready at 05:29:11, yet the payment container logged 'payment gRPC server started on port 8080' only at 05:30:22, and payment's charge / grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge span rate was 0 at every 30s sample from 05:30:00 through 05:32:00 (1.0-1.5/s before and after). So the largest error contribution to the alert traces to the payment Deployment replacement (hypothesis supported by mechanism and timing, not by a single log line stating a connection error). Because the alert's own start (05:28:51, reported value 0.0111) precedes that change and coincides with the chronic frontend-connection-reset 503, and because the alert rule expression and Jaeger spans for the burst window are unavailable, the conclusion is partial.

claims.text: frontend-proxy emits error spans only for span_name 'ingress' and 'router frontend egress', and its status_code label values are STATUS_CODE_ERROR and STATUS_CODE_UNSET; sampled error traces show ingress status http.status_code 503 / otel.status_code ERROR with the child 'router frontend egress' span carrying error="true" and http.status_code 0 (no upstream response).

The frontend-proxy pod's Envoy access log records 503 UC upstream_reset_before_response_started{connection_termination} responses to frontend for GET /api/recommendations?productIds=1YMWWN1N4O at 05:28:13.215, GET /api/products/0PUK6V6EV0 at 05:30:42.801, GET /api/products/66VCHSJNUP at 05:31:41.390 and 05:35:56.019, GET /api/products/9SIQT8TOJO at 05:33:31.178, and GET /api/cart at 05:37:38.783.

frontend-proxy's error-span increase over 5 minutes is non-zero from the first available sample (05:07): 1.11 at 05:09, 2.22 at 05:11, 4.41 at 05:13, 6.67 at 05:15, 1.11-2.22 between 05:17 and 05:23, 0 at the 05:25 and 05:27 samples, 1.11 at 05:29, then 87.78 at 05:31, 133.33 at 05:33, 47.78 at 05:35 and 1.3-2.5 thereafter; the metric series themselves start at 05:07 (source_start_at), so no earlier baseline exists.

Within the 05:28-05:36 log interval, 59 of the 64 matching frontend-proxy access-log lines are 'POST /api/checkout HTTP/1.1" 500 - via_upstream', spanning 05:29:14.322 to 05:30:54.071; the other 5 are the 503 UC upstream_reset lines listed above.

Error-status span rates are non-zero only in the burst window: checkout oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder and oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge (client) show 0.2525 at 05:30:30, 0.2444 at 05:31:00-05:31:30 and 0.2444 at 05:32:00-05:32:30; frontend POST /api/checkout, POST, executing api route (pages) /api/checkout and grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder show 0.4111-0.6556/s in the same interval; all are 0 at every other sample in 05:27-05:41, and no payment-service span_name has a non-zero ERROR rate in that window.

Events in namespace otel-demo show Deployment payment scaling new ReplicaSet payment-7b6bfb9fb4 from 0 to 1 at 05:29:08 and old ReplicaSet payment-55766d76b9 from 1 to 0 at 05:29:11, with ReplicaSet payment-55766d76b9 SuccessfulDelete 'Deleted pod: payment-55766d76b9-cpgm4' at 05:29:11 and pod payment-7b6bfb9fb4-fwlht Scheduled 05:29:08, container Created 05:29:10 and Started 05:29:11.

Deployment payment's pod template carries annotation kubectl.kubernetes.io/restartedAt=2026-11-17T05:29:08Z and still uses image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-payment; its env has no ConfigMap reference (PAYMENT_PORT, FLAGD_HOST, FLAGD_PORT, OTEL_*). Current status is 1 ready/1 available/1 updated replica.

Payment served no charges for about three minutes: the rate of payment's 'charge' and 'grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge' spans is 0 at every 30s sample from 05:30:00 through 05:32:00, while it is 1.23-1.5/s at 05:26:30-05:29:30 and 1.02-1.53/s from 05:32:30 onward.

The new payment container logged 'payment gRPC server started on port 8080' at 05:30:22.877Z, followed by 'Charge request received.'/'Transaction complete.' lines; the pod payment-7b6bfb9fb4-fwlht reported condition Ready=True and ContainersReady=True with lastTransitionTime 2026-11-17T05:29:11Z and restartCount 0.

The otel-demo ConfigMap flagd-config holds key demo.flagd.json, whose flag 'paymentFailure' (description 'Fail payment service charge requests n%') has defaultVariant '100%' (variants off/10%/25%/50%/75%/90%/100%), while every other flag (adFailure, adHighCpu, adManualGc, cartFailure, emailMemoryLeak, imageSlowLoad, kafkaQueueProblems, loadGeneratorFloodHomepage, paymentUnreachable, productCatalogFailure, recommendationCacheFailure) has defaultVariant 'off'.

At query time all 21 otel-demo pods are Running and Ready with restartCount 0 and no lastState, i.e. no crash/OOM record is present; frontend-proxy-6b4d584985-q5c94, frontend-675fd7b5c5-sn9gc and checkout-5dccddf8bb-c4dqt have no previous container instance.

frontend-proxy ingress span throughput stayed roughly 7.0-9.7 spans/s through the whole window (STATUS_CODE_UNSET series), so the error increase is not explained by a traffic surge or a drop in served traffic on the proxy.

The 05:29:14-05:30:54 burst of POST /api/checkout 500s (and therefore the 05:31-05:33 frontend-proxy error spike) is caused by the rollout restart of the single-replica Deployment payment at 05:29:08: the old payment pod was killed at 05:29:11, payment's charge span rate was 0 from 05:30:00 to 05:32:00, its gRPC server only logged starting at 05:30:22, and checkout's PaymentService/Charge client spans were ERROR in that same interval, so checkout had no reachable payment backend and frontend returned 500 to the load generator.

The alert's first non-zero reading (since 05:28:51, reported 0.0111) is attributable to the separate chronic 503 UC upstream_reset_before_response_started{connection_termination} pattern rather than to payment: the 5m error increase was 0 at the 05:25 and 05:27 samples, the next 503 UC line is at 05:28:13, and the payment restart and checkout 500 burst begin at 05:29:08-05:29:14, after the alert start.

The recurring 503 UC upstream_reset_before_response_started{connection_termination} responses arise because the frontend upstream terminates/resets the connection Envoy is using (e.g. keep-alive/idle-connection race in frontend) rather than from frontend application errors; this remains unverified because the frontend container produced no readable log lines in the window and Jaeger returned no spans after ~05:15.

The flagd flag 'paymentFailure' = '100%' is a declared fault-injection setting whose description matches the observed checkout->payment Charge failures, but the observed failure path does not match an application-level 100% charge failure: payment's own charge/grpc server spans were absent (not ERROR) during 05:30:00-05:32:00 and successful 'Transaction complete.' charges resume afterwards, so this flag cannot be confirmed as the trigger from the available evidence (it may also post-date the window, since the ConfigMap reflects only current state).

The frontend service itself shows no error spans over most of the window: its error-status span rates (GET, GET /api/cart, GET /api/data, POST /api/cart, executing api route (pages) /api/cart and /api/data, grpc Cart/Ad/GetAds calls) are 0 at every sample 05:27-05:41, and only the checkout path (POST, POST /api/checkout, executing api route /api/checkout, grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder) is non-zero — so the proxy's chronic 503s are not explained by broad frontend application errors.

The new payment pod was already reporting Ready=True/ContainersReady=True at 05:29:11 (lastTransitionTime) with restartCount 0, so its ~70s absence from charge handling is not explained by a failed readiness probe, crash, eviction or OOM; no Evicted/OOMKilled/BackOff evidence exists for any otel-demo pod in the queried events, which instead contain only the payment rollout's Normal Scheduling/Created/Started/Killing/SuccessfulCreate/SuccessfulDelete/ScalingReplicaSet events.

Review whether a RequestErrorRate threshold of >0 with the reported 0.0111 evaluation is intended, given that frontend-proxy already carried ~1-7 error spans per 5 minutes from the first available sample (05:07) from the recurring 503 UC upstream_reset_before_response_started{connection_termination} lines; a non-zero threshold or longer 'for' would separate this background from real bursts.

For Deployment payment, avoid replacing the only replica in place and make the readiness gate wait for the gRPC listener: the new container logged 'payment gRPC server started on port 8080' at 05:30:22 while the pod was reported Ready at 05:29:11, so checkout saw ~70s with no payment backend.

Enable/expose frontend container logging and keep Jaeger retention covering the incident window so that the recurring upstream_reset_before_response_started{connection_termination} resets (and the POST /api/checkout 500s) can be traced to frontend code paths rather than only to Envoy access-log lines.

Ask the change owner what applied the kubectl rollout restart to Deployment payment at 05:29:08 (restartedAt annotation) and whether the flagd flag paymentFailure='100%' was set at that time; the change-history integration is not available to this investigation, so the trigger of the restart is unknown.

gaps: The RequestErrorRate alerting rule expression is not retrievable: list_prometheus_rules (rule_name RequestErrorRate and type=alert) returned no data from this Prometheus, so the rule's window, denominator and the reported 0.0111 value cannot be reproduced or verified.

Prometheus holds no traces_span_metrics_calls_total samples before 05:07 (source_start_at), so the pre-alert baseline (before 05:28:51, and especially before 05:07) is unknown; the chronic 503s can only be shown from 05:07 onward.

Jaeger returned no traces for checkout (05:28-05:40) or for frontend/frontend-proxy error tags after ~05:15 (latest data_as_of 05:15:52), so the 05:29-05:30 checkout/payment failure burst cannot be inspected at span level (no gRPC status code or error message for the Charge failures).

The frontend container produced no readable log lines for 05:25-05:40 (0 bytes, 0 lines read), so the origin of the upstream_reset_before_response_started{connection_termination} resets inside frontend is unverified.

The rpc_client/server metrics (rpc_client_duration_milliseconds_count, rpc_server_duration_milliseconds_count) returned no series for checkout or payment, so the gRPC status codes (e.g. UNAVAILABLE vs INTERNAL) of the failed Charge calls are unknown.
Queries for networkpolicies and resourcequotas in namespace otel-demo returned nothing (no_data), so network policy or quota causes can be neither confirmed nor excluded.

What or who triggered the payment rollout restart at 05:29:08, and whether the flagd paymentFailure='100%' value was in effect during 05:29-05:34, cannot be established: change_history is listed as not integrated and ConfigMaps expose only current state.
The exact status of the payment Service endpoints and the frontend Deployment's upstream connection settings during 05:29-05:31 are unknown; only current object state was readable.
next_steps: Retrieve the RequestErrorRate rule definition from the Alertmanager/Prometheus configuration owner (rules are not loaded in the queried Prometheus) to confirm the evaluated window and denominator behind 0.0111.

Have the change owner confirm who applied kubectl.kubernetes.io/restartedAt=2026-11-17T05:29:08Z to Deployment payment and whether flagd paymentFailure was changed, using the change-history system that is outside this investigation.
Inspect frontend application logs (once available) for connection resets and POST /api/checkout error handling around 05:28:13-05:31:41 to confirm the keep-alive/connection-termination hypothesis.
Consider a readiness/preStop design change for payment so the gRPC listener is up before the pod is marked Ready, and avoid single-replica in-place restarts.
